subtasks.title: Design multi-tenant data isolation
subtasks.description: Propose and implement row-level tenant isolation across the Postgres schema and the ORM layer so no query can return another tenant's rows, including the reporting queries that currently bypass the ORM.

subtasks.title: Summarize what we decided
